items.question: What is a smart contract and what is it for?
items.answer: A smart contract is a program that runs automatically on the blockchain when certain conditions are met. It eliminates intermediaries, reduces costs and ensures rules are enforced without human intervention.

items.question: Do I need to know about blockchain to work with you?
items.answer: No. We handle all the technical side. We explain how the solution works in clear terms and make decisions together based on your business objectives.

items.question: Which networks do you work with?
items.answer: We primarily work with Ethereum, Polygon and other EVM-compatible networks. We also have experience with Solana and Internet Computer depending on project requirements.

items.question: How long does a blockchain project take?
items.answer: It depends on complexity. A simple smart contract can be ready in 2 to 4 weeks. More complete projects with Web3 integration typically take between 6 and 16 weeks.

items.question: Are the contracts audited?
items.answer: Yes. All our contracts go through security review, exhaustive testing and validation before deployment. For high-value projects we also coordinate specialized external audits.

items.question: Can you integrate blockchain with my existing systems?
items.answer: Yes. We connect your traditional infrastructure with blockchain without needing to rebuild everything from scratch. We design the integration so it doesn't disrupt your current operation.

como_trabajamos.title: HOW WE WORK?
como_trabajamos.text1: Our blockchain process turns your idea into a secure, functional decentralized solution.
como_trabajamos.text2: From use case analysis to mainnet deployment, every step is designed to ensure robust, audited contracts ready for production.

steps.description: We analyze your business model to identify which processes benefit from decentralization, traceability, or automation through smart contracts.
We define the on-chain architecture: blockchain network, contract standards (ERC-20, ERC-721, etc.), business logic, and integration points with existing systems.
We develop smart contracts in Solidity with exhaustive unit tests, edge case coverage, and logic validation before any deployment.
We review the code for vulnerabilities, reentrancy, and other common threats. We guarantee secure, gas-efficient contracts before any deploy.
We deploy to testnet for real-environment validation, then to mainnet with full configuration of wallets, roles, and permissions as designed.
We connect the blockchain solution with your current infrastructure (APIs, databases, frontend) and provide continuous technical support after launch.
